Answers to common questions about plans and billing.
Can I install plugins on any paid WordPress.com plan?

Yes. Plugin installation is available on every paid WordPress.com plan — Personal, Premium, Business, and Commerce. You get access to over 60,000 plugins starting with the Personal plan at /month (billed every 3 years). Choose from 60,000+ plugins, including WooCommerce, Yoast SEO, and MemberPress, or upload your own.
Are there plugins I can’t install?
We filter out a small number of plugins that don’t meet our quality and security standards. You can review the incompatible plugins list
Everything else in the plugin directory is available to you.
What’s included in every WordPress.com paid plan?

Every paid WordPress.com plan starts at /month (billed every 3 years) and includes plugin installation, managed hosting with a global CDN and SSL, DDoS protection, a web application firewall, ad-free sites for your visitors, no limits on pages, posts, users, or visitors, and free support from our expert team. Annual and multi-year plans also include a free domain name for the first year.
How much does WordPress.com cost per month?

WordPress.com plans start at /month when billed every 3 years, or /month billed annually. All paid plans include a free domain for the first year, plugin installation, ad-free browsing for your visitors, and global CDN hosting. There is also a free plan with no expiration date if you want to get started without a credit card.

Yes. Every WordPress.com plan, including the free plan, comes with hosting included. You do not need to purchase hosting separately. All plans include a global CDN, SSL, DDoS protection, brute-force attack protection, and managed WordPress updates.
Do WordPress.com plans include a free domain?

Yes. All annual and multi-year paid plans include a free custom domain for the first year. That covers popular extensions like.com,.net, and.org, among many others. Monthly plans do not include a free domain. If you already own a domain, you can connect it to your WordPress.com site or transfer it to us for easier management. The free plan uses a WordPress.com subdomain (yoursite.wordpress.com) and does not include a custom domain.
What is included in the free WordPress.com plan?

The free plan gives you a WordPress.com subdomain, 1 GB of storage, unlimited pages and posts, and access to basic stats for the last 7 days. It does not include a custom domain, plugin installation, or ad-free browsing for visitors. Paid plans start at /month and unlock all of those features.
What is the difference between WordPress.com and WordPress.org?

WordPress.com is a managed WordPress platform built on open source WordPress. We handle hosting, security, and updates, and what you build belongs to you. Paid plans starting at /month include 60,000+ plugins, thousands of themes, and full customization. WordPress.org is where you download the free software, then buy hosting and manage updates, plugins, and security yourself.
Can I migrate my existing website to WordPress.com?
Yes. Paste your existing site’s address at wordpress.com/move
and we’ll move it for you, risk free. Your old site stays live until you’re ready to switch.
What is the difference between the Business and Commerce plans?

Both plans include developer tools like SFTP/SSH, WP-CLI, Git commands, and GitHub Deployments, plus priority 24/7 support, 50 GB storage, and all premium themes. The Commerce plan adds a fully integrated WooCommerce experience with built-in ecommerce extensions: unlimited products, abandoned cart emails, dynamic upsells, bulk discounts, inventory management, and support for selling in 60+ countries with 0% transaction fees. The Business plan also has 0% transaction fees for WooCommerce payments
Can I switch plans after I sign up?
Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Any unused portion of your current subscription is applied as credit toward your new plan.
Does WordPress.com hosting include security and backups?

Every WordPress.com plan includes malware detection and removal, a web application firewall, DDoS protection, brute-force attack protection, and automated WordPress core updates — at no extra cost. Personal and Premium plans include automated daily backups, and Business, Commerce, and Enterprise plans add real-time backups with one-click restores.
